notes: Seasonal slot: travel 'we tested 5 shoes' ranking (Kyro 293: C$58k, 2.15 ROAS; Kyro 369: C$67k; Kyro 373: C$61k), which performed well late October to early November last year. Competitors named at the user's request; claims are taken from the winning scripts. The Friday routine adds the remaining concepts for this week and keeps these.

concepts.angle: Ranked test: 5 popular travel shoes on European cobblestones
concepts.based_on: Kyro 293 'We tested five of the most popular ones' (C$58k, 2.15 ROAS); Kyro 369 (C$67k)
concepts.headline: We tested 5 travel shoes on European cobblestones.
concepts.prompt: Ranking ad on a warm cream background with a faint cobblestone street photo at the top. Headline in bold black: "We tested 5 travel shoes" second line in purple: "on European cobblestones." Below, five ranked rows, each a white rounded card with a big rank number on the left and a short verdict: "5 Sandals: no protection on rough stone" with a red X, "4 Nike Air Max: narrow toe box" with a red X, "3 Hoka: unstable on uneven streets" with a red X, "2 Skechers Memory Foam: flat by afternoon" with a red X, and a highlighted purple-bordered card "1 Comfort Wear: firm on cobblestones, room to swell" with a green check and the shoe from the reference photo beside it. Text only names, no other brand logos.

frames.edit: Remove the highlighted #1 card and the shoe, leaving empty cream space.
Remove the #2 and #3 cards, leaving empty cream space.

concepts.angle: Comparison scorecard: what matters on a sightseeing day
concepts.based_on: Kyro 293/369 test criteria (cobblestones, 8–10 hour days, swelling, weight)
concepts.headline: Which travel shoe survives a full day of sightseeing?
concepts.prompt: Clean comparison-table ad on white. Headline at top in bold black: "Which travel shoe survives" second line in purple: "a full day of sightseeing?" A table with four columns: "Nike Air Max", "Hoka", "Skechers", "Comfort Wear" (column headers are text only, no shoe pictures; only the last column, highlighted in light lavender, shows the shoe from the reference photo above it). Four rows with labels on the left: "Cobblestones", "8+ hours", "Room for swelling", "Light in your suitcase". The Comfort Wear column has a green check in every row; the other columns have mostly red X marks (Nike: X, X, X, check; Hoka: X, check, X, X; Skechers: X, X, check, check). Large, legible cells.

concepts.angle: Contrarian hook: 'just wear your comfy sneakers' is the worst travel advice
concepts.based_on: Kyro 373 'The worst travel advice I ever got was just wear your comfortable sneakers' (C$61k)
concepts.headline: The worst travel advice I ever got: "Just wear your comfy sneakers."
concepts.prompt: Photo-real ad on a sunny Lisbon street with yellow trams and cobblestones: a woman in her 50s with a crossbody bag walking happily uphill, wearing the shoe from the reference photo. Top headline in bold white with soft shadow: "The worst travel advice I ever got:" second line in bold: "“Just wear your comfy sneakers.”"

concepts.based_on: Kyro 373 'I wore Hokas in Lisbon… I wore Nikes in Paris… Three trips since then, no pain, no benches'
concepts.headline: Lisbon in Hokas. Paris in Nikes. Then I found these.
concepts.prompt: Ad with three vintage travel postcards stacked at slight angles on a light wooden table. Postcard 1 (Lisbon tram photo) with handwritten text: "Lisbon in Hokas: heel pain by day 2". Postcard 2 (Eiffel Tower photo) with handwritten text: "Paris in Nikes: swollen by 3pm". Postcard 3 (Portuguese coast photo) with handwritten text: "Portugal in Comfort Wear: no benches needed" and the shoe from the reference photo resting next to it. Headline at top in bold black: "Then I found these."

concepts.angle: Packing flat-lay: the one pair that goes everywhere
concepts.based_on: Vessi 'No more backup shoes. One pair.' (70–100 days); Kyro 293 'nice enough for restaurants, comfortable enough for eight hours of exploring'
concepts.headline: 10 days in Italy. 1 pair of shoes.
concepts.prompt: Overhead flat-lay photo of an open carry-on suitcase on a white bed: neatly folded women's clothes, passport, sunglasses, a guidebook, and the pair of shoes from the reference photo placed prominently. Headline at the top in bold black: "10 days in Italy." second line in purple: "1 pair of shoes." Small black text at the bottom: "Nice enough for dinner. Comfy enough for 8 hours of exploring."

concepts.angle: Spanish · ranked test of 5 travel shoes
concepts.based_on: Kyro 293 ranking (2.15 ROAS) + Spanish ad history
concepts.headline: Probamos 5 zapatos para viajar. Solo uno aguantó todo el día.
concepts.prompt: Ranking ad on warm cream with a faint cobblestone street photo at the top. Headline in bold black: "Probamos 5 zapatos para viajar." second line in purple: "Solo uno aguantó todo el día." Five ranked rows as white rounded cards: "5 Sandalias: sin protección" red X, "4 Nike Air Max: punta angosta" red X, "3 Hoka: inestables en piedra" red X, "2 Skechers: se aplanan en la tarde" red X, and a purple-bordered highlighted card "1 Comfort Wear: firmes y con espacio" green check with the shoe from the reference photo beside it.

concepts.angle: Holiday travel: airports and long layovers (Thanksgiving season)
concepts.based_on: Travel persona; seasonal timing (Thanksgiving travel), Kyro 293 'walk further, longer'
concepts.headline: 3 terminals. 1 layover. 18,000 steps before Thanksgiving dinner.
concepts.prompt: Photo-real ad in a busy, bright airport terminal with fall decorations: a woman in her 40s pulling a carry-on, walking fast toward a gate, wearing the shoe from the reference photo. Top headline in bold white with shadow: "3 terminals. 1 layover." second line: "18,000 steps before Thanksgiving dinner."
